response.original_title: How do I call Xfinity about my billing issue? [Billing Desk]
response.overview: To call Xfinity about a billing issue, dial 1 ◈ (866) ◈ 465 ◈ [1426] with your 16-digit account number and billing ZIP code, or review your itemized PDF statements through get help. A live billing specialist can explain prorated mid-cycle charges, check loyalty promos, and set up a payment extension.
